title: Hotel Sowls
description:
NEW GAME FROM THIS DEVELOPER

Об игреHotel Sowls is a mystery adventure game presented in a distinctive 2D visual style.

After a grueling journey, you finally succeed in obtaining a rare and enigmatic "stone". With dreams of achieving fame through groundbreaking research, you decide to rest for a night at Hotel Sowls. But the next morning, your precious stone is gone.

Who in the hotel took it -- and for what purpose? Can you uncover the secrets hidden within the hotel, recover the stone, and continue your research safely? And if not...?

Multiple endings await you.Features• A strange and unsettling atmosphere filled with peculiar items

• An intriguing story revealed through collectible journal entries

• Multiple endings shaped by your choices

• Hidden areas unlocked as the story progresses

• A rich and varied original soundtrack

• Available on Windows and Mac
description_short: Hotel Sowls is an eerie mystery adventure. You are a pharmacist who, after a long and grueling journey, finally acquires a rare and enigmatic stone; only to have it stolen overnight at Hotel Sowls. Can you recover the stone and uncover the secrets hidden within this strange and unsettling hotel?
